_about: Public-domain Johannes Evangelista Gossner (1773-1858), Catholic priest turned Lutheran pastor in Berlin and founder of the Gossner Mission, in English translation, for the Word Hoard: The Heavenly Visitant, The Spiritual Casket of Daily Bible Meditations, and John Gossner's Treasury. This shelf is English only. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 101 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
